name: qlrisk_value_at_risk
title: Value at Risk and Expected Shortfall
description: Market-risk VaR and Expected Shortfall for a book: historical, age-weighted (BRW), filtered historical (EWMA), Monte Carlo (normal or Student-t from the return covariance) or parametric (delta-normal); full revaluation or Taylor; optional stressed VaR (the worst 250-day window), Euler component / incremental / standalone decomposition by trade or group, and liquidity-adjusted VaR (half-spread exit cost plus sqrt-of-time scaling). History defaults to a 750-day synthetic history with a stress regime. mode='pnl_series' instead computes VaR/ES from a P&L vector you supply. Example: {"trades": [{"product": "EquityOption", "notional": 1000000, "tenor_years": 0.5, "ticker": "SPX", "strike": 5000, "is_call": false}], "method": "historical", "horizon_days": 10}.
